notice: Suggested oath and conferral sentences. citation_status is needs_verification unless pack_source. Do not treat these as court-required until the user confirms the rule that governs their paper.

oath.heading: CERTIFICATION IN LIEU OF OATH (R. 1:4-4(b))
oath.text: I certify that the foregoing statements made by me are true. I am aware that if any of the foregoing statements made by me are willfully false, I am subject to punishment.
oath.note: New Jersey papers use this verbatim clause. Do not substitute 'to the best of my knowledge'.

oath.heading: Declaration
oath.text: I declare under penalty of perjury under the law of Colorado that the foregoing is true and correct. I signed this on [date] at [city, state].
oath.note: The Uniform Unsworn Declarations Act form often needs a signing date and place. Confirm the current statute and whether your appellate paper uses this declaration. This is a suggested sentence, not a verified requirement.

conferral.heading: Conferral
conferral.text: I conferred with the opposing party on [date]. The opposing party [agrees / takes no position / opposes]. Confirm whether C.R.C.P. 121 § 1-15(8) or the Colorado Appellate Rules govern this paper before filing.
conferral.note: Trial-court civil motions in Colorado often use C.R.C.P. 121 § 1-15(8). Papers in the Colorado Court of Appeals may be governed by C.A.R. instead. Do not treat this label as verified.
